content: Standard FastAPI Clean-Architecture layering: router (HTTP only, 'receive & pass along') -> service/use-case layer (business logic, orchestration) -> repository (persistence). Depends() provides constructor-style DI; APIRouter(dependencies=[...]) applies shared deps per-router. Keep routers thin; never let framework types (Request, UploadFile) leak past the router into domain/service code — map to plain domain args at the boundary, matching the project's existing wire-to-domain boundary pattern.
